constraints: Uses the same algorithm 4D uses to encrypt data (AES-256).

The resulting encryptedBLOB length is always a multiple of 16 bytes; if blobToEncrypt is not itself a multiple of 16 bytes, null bytes are appended automatically, so callers working with non-text files must track the original size themselves to correctly decrypt with Decrypt data BLOB.
Returns False and an empty encryptedBLOB on error.
